description: Newest releases (newest first) across all or selected tools. Successor to latest_releases and release_history (pass since/until for a date window). Default channel=stable, detail=brief.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous truncated response.

detail.description: brief (default) omits infographics and raw notes; standard adds evidence and links; full adds complete release notes.

max_tokens.description: Soft cap on the text response, estimated as ceil(chars/3.5). Default 1500.

since.description: Only releases on/after this ISO date

tools.description: Tool ids (fuzzy: 'claude', 'codex', 'copilot' resolve). Omit for all tools; see list_tools.

until.description: Only releases on/before this ISO date

name: get_latest_releases
title: Latest releases
